Apple Watch Series 12 is a major upgrade to the core health and fitness tracking wearable, with the key being an all-new health sensing system and a more capable heart rate monitor.

The new hardware upgrade not only brings more accurate health data, but even a small functional complication has undergone a big change — this is something I noticed from Apple's promotional materials. This is just one of my expectations for the new Series 12 and Ultra 4.

Apple's heart rate complication gets an upgrade on the Series 12 and Ultra 4 models

I really enjoy glancing at my Apple Watch and seeing my recent heart rate. Keeping a low resting heart rate is a good indicator that I'm doing the right things with my fitness (and stress management).

For this reason, I often use Apple's heart rate complication on the heart rate watch face.

The small circular version is just a launcher showing the heart rate app icon. As for the wide version, it shows the most recent heart rate reading and a chart of heart rate changes since midnight.

I use the wide version because it actually shows information; the app launcher version isn't very useful to me.

However, according to the promotional materials for Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, the smaller heart rate complication appears to be getting a major upgrade.

Apple shows that for the first time it displays actual heart rate values, meaning it can be used as a smaller complication, not just the three-wide version.

The same complication on Apple Watch Series 11 and Ultra 3 running the watchOS 27 candidate release is still just an app launcher.

The reason may be that the new health sensing system reads heart rate every five seconds, a 60-fold improvement over previous Apple Watch versions.

This means the complication can display real-time results. The wide version needs the space to provide background information such as when the heart rate reading was taken.

Small changes like this are examples of how the overall product becomes better through accumulation, and something all users can feel.

Apple Watch Series 12 is now available for pre-order starting at $399. Apple Watch Ultra 4 is now available for pre-order starting at $799. Both models will go on sale a week later on September 18.
